summary: Ubuntu 12.04 (Precise Pangolin) was the fourth LTS release. Desktop and server support both received 5 years, harmonized for the first time, until 28 April 2017. Features: HUD (Head-Up Display) for menu search, improved Unity, Python 3 in archive but Python 2 still default. First LTS with five-year support for desktops. The pangolin (scaly anteater) embodied precision and armor.
notes: Standard support ended 2017-04-28. ESM available until 2019-04-26. Kernel 3.2. Precise was a milestone for LTS parity and long-term stability.
